crew.overview: David Huxley is waiting to get a bone he needs for his museum collection. Through a series of strange circumstances, he meets Susan Vance, and the duo have a series of misadventures which include a leopard called Baby.
crew.title: Bringing Up Baby

details.biography:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

George Hively (September 6, 1889 – March 2, 1950) was a film writer and film editor from 1917 to 1945. He was nominated for an Academy Award for Best Film Editing on the 1935 film The Informer. He was the father of George Hively and Jack Hively, both editors in film and television.
details.name: George Hively
